thread.title: Small Caps Lead, But 2 Factors Hang Over Stock Market | Investor's Business Daily

author: PAUL WHITFIELD
title: Small Caps Lead, But 2 Factors Hang Over Stock Market | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Small caps led the stock market with a 1.4% pop in late morning action Thursday, but the major U.S. stock indexes couldn't quite match the pace. Bulls are hoping for confirmation of a new uptrend, but two factors encourage caution.
X The Nasdaq rose 1%, just off the small-cap Russell 2000's 1.4% pace. The Dow Jones industrial average and the S&P 500 added 0.8% and 0.7% respectively.
Volumes fell on both major exchanges.
Two factors hanging over the market are looming results from America's largest stock by market value and a key secondary indicator that remains bearish.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Apple ( AAPL ), America's No. 1 stock in market value, will report fiscal Q4 and full-year results after the close. The fiscal year ended in September. The Street expects 34% growth in quarterly earnings and 28% for the full year. Revenue growth is estimated at 17% for the quarter and 15% for the full year.
Apple is trying to retake its 50-day moving average. While many stocks have lost both their 50-day line and their 200-day moving average, Apple is 13% above its 200-day line and only 1.5% under its 50-day line.
If Apple were to stumble, some market watchers fear the market's reaction. But if Apple delivers, bulls hope that would usher in a new market uptrend.
The secondary indicator lending credibility to the bearish case is new lows vs. new highs. Lows have dominated IBD's list since late September. The apparent peak in ugliness came on Oct. 26 when new lows outnumbered new highs by a 38-1 ratio.
On Thursday, preliminary data showed new lows outnumbering new highs by a 5-2 ratio.
The lack of new highs suggests market leadership has narrowed, never a good sign.
Starbucks To Report Another company that will report after the close is Starbucks ( SBUX ), the second-biggest restaurant stock by market cap. (Only McDonald's ( MCD ) is bigger.) Starbucks is working on a long consolidation. The stock is 5% under its late January high.
Both Starbucks and Apple have sizable exposure to China.
Among IBD's 197 industry groups, the day's leaders included trucks and parts; generic drugs; and recreational vehicles. The day's weakest players included diversified operations; food; and utilities.
